descriptionMarkdown:
Exotic wargear is unusual but reproducible. It may appear through elite armouries, xenos contacts, Mechanicus vaults, 
black markets or specialist patrons.
Item Availability Effect
Inferno Pistol Exceptional 2d10 fire; 20/60 ft; Light, Armour-Breaking, Reload 2. Aeldari-pattern cells 
and maintenance are normally required.
Grav-Pistol Rare 1d10 force; 40/120 ft; Armour-Breaking, Reload 6. Once per turn against 
AC 17+, a vehicle or a structure, deal +1d6 force damage.
Item Availability Effect
Grav-Gun Exceptional
2d8 force; 60/180 ft; Heavy, Armour-Breaking, Reload 6. On a hit against 
AC 17+, a vehicle or a Large or larger creature, it must pass a Strength 
saving throw or lose 10 ft Speed until your next turn.
Digital Weapon Rare
Concealed accessory. Once per short rest, after you hit a creature within 10 
ft, deal +1d6 radiant or fire damage. It is not found without a deliberate 
search or suitable auspex.
Null Rod Exceptional
While held, gain advantage on saves against psychic and daemonic effects. 
Once per short rest, use your reaction to reduce psychic or force damage to 
you by 2d8; a Warp-using source also gains +1 Warp Pressure.
Rosarius Exceptional
Force-field icon. Once per short rest, use your reaction to reduce damage 
to yourself by 2d8 + proficiency bonus. If this reduces the damage to 0, gain 
advantage on your next fear or Corruption save before the end of your next 
turn.
Displacer Field Near-Unique
Once per short rest, when an attack hits you, use your reaction to teleport 
up to 10 ft to an unoccupied space you can see and halve the triggering 
damage. If no safe space exists, the reaction cannot be used.
Conversion Beamer Exceptional 2d10 force; 120/360 ft; Heavy, Beam, Emplaced, Reload 2. If the primary 
target is at least 60 ft away, add +1d10 force damage.
Teleport Homer Rare
Action to deploy. Once per long rest, a friendly teleport, drop or extraction 
that can lock onto the homer may arrive within 10 ft of it without scatter or 
positional error, subject to campaign access.
Stasis Grenade Exceptional
Consumable. 10-ft radius; Constitution save. Failure: Restrained and 
Incapacitated until the start of the thrower's next turn. Success: Speed 
halved and no reactions for the same duration.
